mapper.select: SELECT resource_id,title,body_markdown,created_by_member_id,updated_by_member_id,created_dttm,updated_dttm,deleted_dttm FROM resource WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} AND
SELECT resource_id,title,body_markdown,created_by_member_id,updated_by_member_id,created_dttm,updated_dttm,deleted_dttm FROM resource WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} AND FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.resource_id,r.title,r.body_markdown,creator.name AS created_by_name,r.updated_dttm, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_file rf WHERE rf.resource_id=r.resource_id) AS attachment_count, COALESCE((SELECT rf.stored_file_id FROM resource_file rf JOIN stored_file sf ON sf.stored_file_id=rf.stored_file_id WHERE rf.resource_id=r.resource_id AND sf.content_type LIKE 'image/%' ORDER BY rf.display_order LIMIT 1),(SELECT lp.preview_image_file_id FROM resource_link_preview lp WHERE lp.resource_id=r.resource_id AND lp.preview_image_file_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY lp.resource_link_preview_id LIMIT 1)) AS cover_stored_file_id, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resource_file rf JOIN stored_file sf ON sf.stored_file_id=rf.stored_file_id WHERE rf.resource_id=r.resource_id AND sf.content_type LIKE 'image/%') THEN 'ATTACHMENT' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resource_link_preview lp WHERE lp.resource_id=r.resource_id AND lp.preview_image_file_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'LINK_PREVIEW' ELSE NULL END AS cover_image_source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource_link_preview lp WHERE lp.resource_id=r.resource_id) AS link_preview_count FROM resource r JOIN member creator ON creator.member_id=r.created_by_member_id WHERE r.deleted_dttm IS NULL AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.body_markdown LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR creator.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY r.updated_dttm DESC,r.resource_id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource r JOIN member creator ON creator.member_id=r.created_by_member_id WHERE r.deleted_dttm IS NULL AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.body_markdown LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR creator.name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%'))

SELECT r.resource_id,r.title,r.body_markdown,creator.name created_by_name,updater.name updated_by_name,r.created_dttm,r.updated_dttm,r.created_by_member_id FROM resource r JOIN member creator ON creator.member_id=r.created_by_member_id JOIN member updater ON updater.member_id=r.updated_by_member_id WHERE r.resource_id=#{resourceId} AND r.deleted_dttm IS NULL

SELECT rf.stored_file_id,rf.display_order,rf.uploaded_by_member_id,uploader.name uploaded_by_name,rf.created_dttm uploaded_dttm FROM resource_file rf JOIN member uploader ON uploader.member_id=rf.uploaded_by_member_id WHERE rf.resource_id=#{resourceId} ORDER BY rf.display_order,rf.resource_file_id
SELECT normalized_url,domain,title,description,preview_image_file_id FROM resource_link_preview WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} ORDER BY resource_link_preview_id
SELECT preview_image_file_id FROM resource_link_preview WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} AND preview_image_file_id IS NOT NULL
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resource_file rf JOIN resource r ON r.resource_id=rf.resource_id WHERE rf.resource_id=#{resourceId} AND rf.stored_file_id=#{storedFileId} AND r.deleted_dttm IS NULL)

SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM resource_link_preview lp JOIN resource r ON r.resource_id=lp.resource_id WHERE lp.resource_id=#{resourceId} AND lp.preview_image_file_id=#{storedFileId} AND r.deleted_dttm IS NULL)

UPDATE resource SET deleted_dttm=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE resource_id=#{resourceId} AND deleted_dttm IS NULL
